rights.notes: Only independently written factual metadata and outbound links are redistributed; no source prose or creative asset is copied.

review.notes: Claims were checked against the linked primary or regulatory source. Evidence and causality are stated conservatively; independent human review is encouraged.

objective: Maintain favorable on-site product ratings and conversion signals.
businessContext: On-site ratings and reviews materially influence purchase decisions and post-purchase feedback can expose product dissatisfaction.
strategy: Publish favorable reviews while withholding lower-rated submissions, as charged by the FTC.
outcomes: The FTC order required $4.2 million in monetary relief and prohibited misrepresentation of customer reviews.
The FTC later distributed nearly $2.4 million across 148,351 payments to eligible customers.
whatFailed: The system converted lifecycle feedback into misleading acquisition proof by selectively hiding dissatisfaction.
transferConditions: Use for review systems, post-purchase email, social proof and marketplace governance.
nonTransferConditions: Do not infer that neutral spam, abuse or relevance moderation is prohibited when policies are transparent and applied consistently.
